general.text: Travel insurance is MANDATORY from January 2026 — Georgian law. You cannot enter without it.
No ATMs in mountain villages — always bring Georgian Lari cash.
No shops above 2000m altitude — stock up food and water before going to mountains.
Phone signal is unreliable in mountains — download your PDF before going.
Georgia is a very safe country for tourists.

road_warnings.text: Tusheti is OPEN — enjoy the most remote region of Georgia (open June-October)
Batumi Black Sea — swimming season is open
Svaneti — always requires 4WD vehicle for mountain roads
Gudauri — summer hiking season, ski season December-April

seasonal_tips: High season July — book hotels 2-3 weeks in advance
Mountains are the best escape from Tbilisi heat in summer
Batumi beach is perfect — warm Black Sea water
Tusheti is open — most remote and beautiful region of Georgia

transport_prices.note: Prices approximate for summer 2026. Verify locally.
